name: compustat_std
inputs_note: the fundamentals stage is a parameter (--fund-stage); task 5 rebuilds on fundamentals_v11. Reads <fund stage>/{events,catalog,quarterly_history}.parquet, <fund stage>/_work/cf (Company Facts extract), earnings_calendar/announcements.parquet, reference/fx_daily.parquet
staleness: a row describes datadate as known at available_at; consumers bound staleness by session - datadate (e.g. <= 400 days) or by the next expected filing

outputs.doc: Compustat-shaped PIT quarterly fundamentals (fundq), filing and restatement vintages (vintage_kind); rdq informational
Compustat-shaped PIT annual fundamentals (funda): annual-form base periods with fqtr 4 and their later restatement vintages; 81 catalog fields, including non-Compustat extensions tempeq and nicon

asof_macros.fundq_asof: CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO fundq_asof(ts) AS TABLE SELECT * FROM read_parquet('<root>/compustat_std/fundq.parquet') WHERE available_at < CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY cik, datadate ORDER BY available_at DESC, accession DESC) = 1
asof_macros.funda_asof: CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO funda_asof(ts) AS TABLE SELECT * FROM read_parquet('<root>/compustat_std/funda.parquet') WHERE available_at < CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY cik, datadate ORDER BY available_at DESC, accession DESC) = 1

asof_note: fundq_asof(ts) / funda_asof(ts): per (cik, datadate) the latest vintage with available_at < ts (ts a naive UTC TIMESTAMP); identical to the stagelake vintage <view>_as_of macro with keys (cik, datadate) and order (available_at, accession). <root> = the alpha-panel build root.
